submittedParameters.prompt: NARROW BOOT-ORIENTATION CORRECTION. Edit ONLY the current grounded anatomical RIGHT boot at lower screen-right in Image1. Keep EXACT Image1 canvas, camera, head, hair, body, hands, full left-hand bow, right-shoulder quiver, clothes, BOTH thighs/knees/shins and raised left boot completely unchanged. Preserve the right boot's ankle/cuff and the HEEL CONTACT at its same exact screen position. The error is that the shoe toe extends too far sideways toward screen-right like a side profile. Image2 (NE07) is the correct right shoe orientation reference only: heel nearest viewer/lower-left, toe recedes away upper-right, short foreshortened toe. Keep natural boot design, jade cuff beads/tassel, ivory material and gold trim. Do NOT move the whole foot across ground, move body, swap legs, copy a frame, mirror, stretch or zoom. Image3 is primary approved bright clean hand-painted style only. One independent NE run12 transparent RGBA frame at exact same canvas composition, no floor/shadow/text/effects.
